channel.title: Usage Updates
channel.description: Claude and ChatGPT usage resets, temporary boosts, free access and credits.

item.title: Anthropic — Usage boost: Claude Code weekly limits extended 50% higher through August 31
item.description: We're extending the 50% increase to weekly Claude Code limits through August 31. We hope to make this a permanent change to our plans, but strong demand for our models means that capacity may be tight over the coming weeks. We'll keep you posted as things develop.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage boost: ChatGPT Free referral campaign doubles usage limits in India, Indonesia, and Mexico
item.description: Selected ChatGPT Free users in India, Indonesia, and Mexico can double their usage limits for seven days per successful referral, up to three times, from August 18 to September 17, 2026.

item.title: OpenAI — Free access: Elevated errors in ChatGPT conversations for Free users
item.description: ChatGPT conversations for Free

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: ChatGPT Work and Codex usage limits reset for 15M active-user milestone
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “Old news actually from a bunch of days ago, but crossed that 15M. Enjoy a nice reset everyone. Landing in the next hour or so, go /fast.”

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: OpenAI reset Codex and ChatGPT Work usage limits again for Monday
item.description: Usage limits have been reset for all paid ChatGPT Work and Codex users. Happy Monday you all. Hope it is a fantastic week.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: OpenAI delivered the promised Monday reset for Codex and ChatGPT Work users
item.description: Tibo confirmed the Monday reset he had promised was delivered for Codex and ChatGPT Work: "Just like any other reset, but picture me doing a little dance with it."

item.title: OpenAI — Credits: ChatGPT Business Premium seat sign-ups earn up to $500 in credits
item.description: Up to 10,000 eligible workspaces that sign up before August 20, 2026 can receive $100 in workspace credits (2,500 credits) for each qualifying Premium seat they add, up to five seats.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: ChatGPT Work and Codex usage limits reset to celebrate Sol in the CC harness
item.description: That's right, GPT-5.6 Sol is awesome and can be used pretty much anywhere, including in the CC harness. To celebrate this, together with the fact that I'm not going anywhere... I have reset usage limits for all paid users of ChatGPT Work and Codex. Have fun out there!

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: Codex and ChatGPT Work usage limits reset again for a “week of efficiency”
item.description: To celebrate a week of efficiency and let you run 100,000 Luna threads this weekend, I've reset usage limits for Codex and ChatGPT Work.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage boost: OpenAI cuts Luna and Terra prices, stretches Codex and ChatGPT Work usage further
item.description: Luna and Terra's lower prices are reflected in how usage is counted in Codex and ChatGPT Work, so your usage goes further.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: ChatGPT Work and Codex usage limits reset, Sol usage lasts about 18% longer
item.description: I've reset usage limits for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users... we have not reduced usage on any subscription plans... we expect your usage to last around 18% longer during typical use of Sol.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: Codex and ChatGPT Work usage limits reset again for all paid users
item.description: Back at the laptop. The usage limits have been reset for all paid users of Codex and ChatGPT Work. Weeeeeeeee. It's a good day!

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: ChatGPT Work and Codex usage limits reset after near-global outage
item.description: We have reset usage limits for all Codex and ChatGPT Work users. Last night around 2am to 4am we suffered an almost global outage. All well and recovered, but you know what comes next. We learn. We reset. Enjoy.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: ChatGPT Work and Codex usage limits reset for 10M active-user milestone
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “10M! New day, new usage reset for paid users of Codex and ChatGPT Work. Lands in the next hour. Enjoy.”

item.title: OpenAI — Credits: OpenAI offers $100 ChatGPT Work credit to first 10,000 users who post about it
item.description: Greg Brockman (OpenAI): “We're doing the promotion again, except this time for ChatGPT Work: Tweet what you love about ChatGPT Work, claim $100 in free credits, get more work done. First 10k get the free tokens.”

item.title: Anthropic — Usage boost: Claude Cowork limits doubled and Claude Code limits raised 50%
item.description: Claude Code weekly limits were raised 50% through August 19. Cowork limits were doubled through August 5.

item.title: Anthropic — Usage boost: Claude Code weekly limits kept 50% higher through August 19
item.description: We're also keeping Claude Code weekly limits 50% higher, now through August 19, for all Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise users.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: ChatGPT Work and Codex limits reset again
item.description: “Oops... I did it again. Enjoy reset usage limits for all paid users for Codex and ChatGPT Work.”

item.title: Anthropic — Credits: Pro and Team Standard users get a $100 Fable 5 credit
item.description: Anthropic gave Pro and Team Standard users a one-time $100 credit for Fable 5 after included access ended. Max and Team Premium users kept Fable 5 within 50% of their weekly limits.

item.title: Anthropic — Credits: Claude refunds overcharges and grants matching credit after Fable 5 glitch
item.description: A July 17 bug wrongly required usage credits to access Fable 5 on claude.ai and Claude Code for Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise users; Anthropic refunded any extra usage charged during the outage and added a matching credit to affected accounts.

item.title: Anthropic — Usage reset: Claude limits reset for all users for a third week
item.description: Anthropic reset the 5-hour and weekly limits for all users for the third week in a row.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: Codex and ChatGPT Work usage limits reset for 9M active-user milestone
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “Another reset for our Codex and ChatGPT Work users. Actually hit 9M active users way earlier today... Should have that sweet 100% weekly usage limit back in a few [minutes].”

item.title: OpenAI — Credits: OpenAI offers $100 Codex credit to first 10,000 users who post about GPT-5.6 Sol
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “What if we gave you $100 in Codex credits if you tell us what you love about GPT-5.6 Sol or why you switched? Tweet it, claim your gift, enjoy more usage. First 10k get the free tokens.”

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: ChatGPT Work and Codex usage limits reset for 8M active-user milestone
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “We have reached 8M active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work. We are once again resetting the usage limits for all. And we continue to not have the 5h rate limit as well.”

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: Codex and ChatGPT Work users get a banked reset at 7M users
item.description: OpenAI added one banked reset to every Codex and ChatGPT Work account after reaching 7 million active users. Users could apply it whenever they chose.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage boost: OpenAI passes inference savings to Codex, ChatGPT Work for about 10% more usage
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “We have landed inference optimizations and are passing down savings to all the subscriptions for GPT-5.6 Sol. That should result in around 10% more usage on its own.”

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: 500,000 users get a banked reset after reset-button bug
item.description: A reset-button bug affected fewer than 10% of users during a two-hour window. OpenAI gave a banked reset to all 500,000 accounts that pressed the button during that period.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage boost: 5-hour limit temporarily removed for ChatGPT Plus, Pro and Business
item.description: “Temporarily removing the 5 hour usage limit restriction for all Plus, Business and Pro plans.” The change applied to Codex and ChatGPT Work; weekly limits remained in place.

item.title: Anthropic — Free access: Claude Fable 5 access and 50% higher Claude Code weekly limits extended through July 19
item.description: We're extending Claude Fable 5 access on all paid plans, as well as keeping Claude Code’s weekly rate limits 50% higher, through July 19.

item.title: OpenAI — Usage reset: Another ChatGPT Work and Codex usage limit reset over the weekend
item.description: Tibo Sottiaux (OpenAI): “Introducing... another usage limit reset for all our ChatGPT Work and Codex users. Should land over next 30 minutes... we have never seen traffic increase so quickly.”
